rgkqqze9.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree captures the holiday magic with its vibrant design and season-inspired aesthetic. Perfect for those seeking a modern twist on a traditional favorite, this tree marries simplicity with elegance, fitting seamlessly into any living room, garden, or terrace. The contemporary style—characterized by clean lines and minimal ornamentation—brings a sleek look to any festive setting, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. PVC and Steel Build: Constructed from a blend of PVC and steel, this artificial tree offers a robust structure designed to last season after season. The abrasion-resistant material ensures longevity, while the steel stand provides excellent stability, easy to assemble with just a screwdriver. Energy-Efficient LED Lights: Equipped with LED string lights, this tree features energy-saving properties and dynamic lighting patterns. With 8 distinct flash modes, these lights illuminate the tree in intricate patterns, creating vibrant light displays that enhance any holiday décor. Convenient USB Power Source: This tree's innovative USB connectivity offers flexible power options, making it easy to power up without needing a traditional outlet. Simply plug it into a portable power bank or any compatible device, offering hassle-free setup. Stylish Modern Design: The cone-shaped frame and modern design elements make this tree a stylish addition to homes or outdoor spaces with shelter. Its sleek appearance fits smoothly into minimalist or contemporary setups, enhancing the visual appeal of any seasonal scene. Easy Assembly and Care: Designed for ease, assembling this tree is simple. With only a screwdriver and a partner needed, it's ready to impress. Follow care instructions for assembly efficiently, ensuring the tree remains a staple holiday decoration for years. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 380 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: White Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

hxxs39a5.sourceDescription: Come December, you want your Christmas decorations to impress your guests – and nothing does that better than a bedazzling bauble wreath! A simple yet eye-catching design, this modern 56cm red Christmas wreath looks the part on any festive front door, over any mantlepiece and even as centrepieces on your Christmas dinner table. Our bauble Xmas wreaths come pre-fitted to a robust plastic holder and hanger, so all you need to do is attach to your favourite Yuletide spot – no assembly required! Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

2aajjw72.baseName: Walplus Polypropylene Christmas Tree Skirt - White - dia 65x23 cm
2aajjw72.variantName: Walplus Polypropylene Christmas Tree Skirt - White - dia 65x23 cm
2aajjw72.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree skirt is an excellent decoration that creates a joyful Christmas atmosphere! Durable material: Polypropylene is a popular plastic that is widely used in the production of outdoor and indoor furniture. It is lightweight, robust, and weather-resistant.Beautiful woven look: The woven-style design gives the tree collar a stylish and rustic appearance, complementing both traditional and modern Christmas decor.Easy to assemble: With quick connection assembly system, this tree collar can be quickly set up without the need for any specialized tools, saving you time and effort during the busy holiday season.Easy to maintain: Thanks to its smooth surface, the tree collar is easy to clean with a damp cloth and requires less maintenance. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: Polypropylene Top diameter: 55 cm Bottom diameter: 65 cm Height: 23 cm Woven-style design Assembly required: Yes This christmas tree skirt is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and floor protection. To prevent severe fire hazards or property damage, never allow the fabric to come into direct contact with open flames, hot candles, or exposed electrical wiring from holiday lights. Inspect all tree light strands for frayed cords before placing them near the skirt. Ensure the skirt is laid completely flat around the base of the tree stand to avoid creating a dangerous tripping hazard for residents or guests. Do not block access to water reservoirs on live trees. This seasonal textile product is not a toy; keep all decorative ties, metallic trim, small sequins, and plastic packaging completely out of the reach of infants, small children, and pets. Manufacturer Name: WALPLUS Address: Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingdom Contact: customer.service@walplus.com
